tests.procedure: Start from a clean test room with the actual ready adapter, dry character and exactly one of each owner.
tests.expected: Started opens the native session menu; no campaign is created and no save file is written until the player selects New or Continue.

tests.procedure: Supply null, a base adapter, and then an unready real adapter.
tests.expected: Blocked with a specific diagnostic; no fake inventory, save, receipt or hidden pickup.

tests.procedure: Call before possession, from the wrong actor, and from an unregistered bootstrap.
tests.expected: Blocked before any real provider method is called.

tests.procedure: Duplicate the UI, interaction bridge, bootstrap, controller or director component.
tests.expected: Specific ownership error; no selection of an arbitrary duplicate.

tests.procedure: Supply an editor/class-default or other-world director/provider to the play-world component.
tests.expected: Blocked before provider reads or binding.

tests.procedure: Run a networked PIE session.
tests.expected: Blocked; no implied co-op support.

tests.procedure: Execute a legacy Configure or InitializeUI call before the new startup entry point.
tests.expected: Blocked; the old session is not rebound or silently replaced.

tests.procedure: Delete the authored fuse actor in a disposable test map.
tests.expected: room.missing_object identifies world.test.fuse; room editing is not auto-repaired.

tests.procedure: Configure the battery pickup as a fuse or a quantity of two.
tests.expected: room.item_mismatch blocks startup; no duplicate critical grants.

tests.procedure: Duplicate or change a stable world ID; then add an unexpected persistent object.
tests.expected: A diagnostic identifies duplicate, malformed, missing or unexpected IDs; ordinary unregistered scenery remains allowed.

tests.procedure: Remove the optional postcard actor or set the wrong journal entry.
tests.expected: Authoring validation fails; this is a test-room manifest requirement, not a new quest prerequisite.

tests.procedure: Attempt startup after a pickup/door/note proxy already has active state.
tests.expected: Pristine-room check fails; no independent pre-restore is accepted.

tests.procedure: Use a NaN/nonunit/out-of-bounds, obstructed, no-floor or unsafe-tagged checkpoint, and an invalid current spawn.
tests.expected: Blocked through the same dry-placement helper used by saving; no teleport or inventory mutation.

tests.procedure: Use legacy PlayerInput or remove the Enhanced Input local-player subsystem.
tests.expected: Blocked before menu binding; no ClearAllMappings workaround.

tests.procedure: Return incompatible/empty export, invalid identity, or validation failure from the actual adapter.
tests.expected: Explicit provider diagnostic; no Configure call.

tests.procedure: Return invalid backpack/storage views, mismatched revisions or a shared instance GUID.
tests.expected: Blocked; actual storage must be initialized even when empty.

tests.procedure: Pregrant either required part to backpack or storage, or retain a previous receipt ledger.
tests.expected: Blocked; radio parts remain supplied by the two guaranteed world pickups.

tests.procedure: Make read calls change revision/identity/receipts or report Available for an absent individual part.
tests.expected: The corresponding consistency check fails. This test does not establish all vendor side-effect freedom.

tests.procedure: First fail read-only preflight, fix the setup, then invoke StartTestRoom explicitly.
tests.expected: Retry is allowed from Blocked only; no timer retries or polling loops occur.

tests.procedure: Invoke the same valid request twice and attempt a different director/provider/checkpoint after success.
tests.expected: Same request returns AlreadyStarted without duplicate UI/contexts; different request returns Rejected without rebind.

tests.procedure: Call StartTestRoom from provider callbacks and synchronously from OnStartupNotice.
tests.expected: Busy during the active attempt/notification; no recursive binding.

tests.procedure: In a disposable host inject a Configure/bridge/UI initialization failure after preflight.
tests.expected: RestartRequired; coordinator mutation/save entry is poisoned; owned movement/look locks held until teardown. No in-place retry.

tests.procedure: End PIE/relaunch after success and after binding failure while another input owner has locks.
tests.expected: No leftover startup debug message; only bootstrap-owned failure locks released. Native UI retains its own teardown responsibility.

tests.procedure: With bootstrap used instead of the legacy calls, complete pickup, storage transfer, repair, transcript, verified save, relaunch and Continue with keyboard and gamepad.
tests.expected: All retained M1/M1.2 campaign/UI checks still pass; no loss, duplicate grants or false save notices.

tests.procedure: Run the read-only editor audit on valid, invalid and dirty test maps, then during PIE and with an existing report file.
tests.expected: Only loaded-world manifest facts reported; no asset edit/save, vendor call, file overwrite or runtime pass claim.

tests.procedure: Build and package the actual Development Windows test room; launch outside Unreal Editor.
tests.expected: Startup and full campaign loop work in the executable. Record exact versions and evidence; the gate is not met by an editor-only audit.
